# >>> highland-supabase: hs-db.avunjian.com (added by deploy/hs-supabase/caddy.sh; do not edit between the marks) >>>
hs-db.avunjian.com {
	request_body {
		max_size 512KB
	}
	# the Auth routes the page uses, and no other
	@signin path /auth/v1/settings /auth/v1/authorize /auth/v1/callback /auth/v1/logout /auth/v1/health
	handle @signin {
		reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8200
	}
	@token {
		path /auth/v1/token
		query grant_type=pkce grant_type=refresh_token
	}
	handle @token {
		reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8200
	}
	@user {
		path /auth/v1/user
		method GET HEAD OPTIONS
	}
	handle @user {
		reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8200
	}
	# the game's functions, and only those
	@game path /rest/v1/rpc/hs_*
	handle @game {
		reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8200
	}
	# nothing else of the Supabase is served on this name
	handle {
		respond 404
	}
}
# <<< highland-supabase <<<
